Not saying you're necessarily wrong, but that's an awfully large leap in logic. It does not necessarily logically follow that because abusive parents spawn neglectful parents, that neglectful parents necessarily spawn abusive ones. Even if we do see a large amount of abusive parents coming from neglectful homes, correlation does not imply causation. Also, this is anecdotal, but my own parents both came from abusive households. So I don't think one necessarily spawns the other...it all depends on the individual, how they mentally and emotionally develop, what coping skills (or lack thereof) they develop in their lifetime, etc. In other words, I suspect it's a multitude of factors, rather than any one boogeyman factor. Things are not usually so simple in our world.
